en:
Hey, Tsumugi. Why did you first
start making cosplay?
What!? That's where you jump to!?

Ah, if you'd rather not say,
you don't have to...

It's not that I don't want to say...
It's just...a little embarrassing...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi blushed and brought
her fist to her chin, thinking.
Hmm...where to start...?

From a young age, I loved clothes 
that were cool or cute.

Anime was full of clothes like that, so 
every weekend, I'd be glued to the TV.

One day, I eventually learned 
of a thing called cosplay...

As soon as I did, I went and secretly 
made my favorite character's outfit.

That's amazing!
You made it from scratch?

No, it was too hard to make from scratch, 
so I modified an existing outfit.

But even though I made it, I didn't have
the courage to wear it to a con.

But even so, I wanted someone 
to see it!
Do you understand that feeling?

I think I do. You worked
really hard.

Right, right! Humans are just lumps 
of desire that need acknowledgement.

And so, I dared to put it up 
on the internet.

Th-Thinking back on it now, showing an 
outfit like that is so embarrassing...

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi is squirming.
I understand how she feels...

That fandom was full of nice people, 
so they didn't make fun of me...

Actually, a certain cosplayer said 
it was good for my first time.

That compliment was enough 
for me, but...

Then they said they wanted to wear it 
and that we should go to a con together.

To my surprise, they were a really
famous cosplayer in that fandom!

Is that right?
Well, did you go?

Of course! It was more fun then I even 
imagined! I couldn't believe it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi's eyes are sparkling.
It must have been a lot of fun.

Looking back, that cosplayer just wanted 
to drag others into the cosplay swamp.

And I was dragged in quite easily.
But still, I'm thankful.

And that was the start of your
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltNORMAL> talent, right?

Yeah, if I hadn't been invited to that 
con, I wouldn't be the person I am now.

I'm still friends with that cosplayer. 
I want to make more outfits for them...

Oh...what kind of tone have I 
been setting!?
I'd love to hear more about it
That's a good story!
It's okay, I asked
Are you unsure of something?

I'm so embarrassed...I made you listen 
to that plain, boring story...

I'd love to hear more about it.
These stories are fascinating.
Huh!?
Wh-What!? Did I say something wrong?

I've never heard that line outside 
of girls' manga or dating sims!
<CLT=cltMIND>Her eyes are getting sparkly again!

If you were in a dating sim, you wouldn't 
be the most popular, but you'd have fans.

<CLT=cltMIND>...Is that a compliment?
I have no idea.
That's a good story!

Yeah...I don't really tell many 
people this story.

Because it's embarrassing, of course, 
but also because it's important to me...

But I thought it'd be okay if I 
told it to you, Shuichi.
Me?

Because you're interested in cosplay, 
right? It's my turn to drag someone in.
What!?

That and...you didn't seem like you'd 
make fun of people's memories.
It's okay, I asked...

Yeah, but...you're not disappointed by 
how plain and boring it was, right?

Not at all! I'm happy to hear
stories like that.

R-Really? Well, if you enjoyed it, 
then it's fine.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tsumugi's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Tsumugi told me a few more cosplay
stories, and I returned to my room.
